notes: Plan-only release evals. Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject; branch, tracker, command, and deploy choices come from bindings. Refusal is fatal and policy is never defaulted or inferred.

evals.name: casual-trigger-with-deploy-emphasis
evals.prompt: Plan a release and deploy watch.
evals.expected_output: Use one retained ResolvedProject and its bindings.vcs, bindings.tracker, bindings.commands, bindings.workflow.release, and deploy capability. Preserve changelog, PR, CI, merge, and configured deploy monitoring; unsupported deploy is skipped only through its capability state.

evals.name: verbose-step-by-step-request
evals.expected_output: After one ResolvedProject resolution, derive every command and branch from retained bindings. Resolver refusal is fatal; blocked stops and no value is defaulted or inferred.

evals.name: specific-gotcha-emphasized
evals.prompt: Plan a release while guarding rollback.
evals.expected_output: Use retained bindings for the existing PR and deploy verification path, including commit identity verification. Do not infer platform or branch policy.

evals.name: single-branch-kind-none-local-release
evals.expected_output: One retained ResolvedProject identifies tracker and deploy capability states. Follow the documented tracker-free and unsupported-deploy routes only when declared; resolver refusal is fatal and there is no default behavior.
